name: SpecDown
subtitle: Markdown for your AI workflow

ios.promotional_text: Review AI-generated Markdown on iPhone and iPad. Read specs, explore Mermaid diagrams, and check the details wherever you work.
ios.description:
SpecDown is a reading companion for your AI workflow. Open the Markdown your AI tool creates and review it as a clear, readable document on iPhone and iPad.

Read specs, plans, READMEs and technical notes with formatted tables, highlighted code and interactive Mermaid diagrams. Use the result to check the details and decide what to ask for next.

REVIEW YOUR DOCUMENTS
• Open Markdown from Files or iCloud Drive
• Read headings, lists, tables and code with clear formatting
• Jump between sections with the table of contents
• Switch to the raw Markdown source
• Keep several documents open in tabs

EXPLORE THE DIAGRAMS
• View flowcharts, sequence diagrams, state diagrams and Gantt charts
• Open a diagram fullscreen to zoom and pan
• Read in light or dark appearance

KEEP YOUR WORK CLOSE
• Open direct links to Markdown files
• Bookmark documents you want to return to
• Review saved documents away from your desk

Create and revise documents in your preferred AI tool or editor, then open the saved Markdown in SpecDown. It also works with documents written entirely by people.

No account is needed. SpecDown has no ads or analytics. Documents render on your device; opening online documents or remote images connects directly to their hosts.

mac.promotional_text: Keep a clear preview beside your AI tool. SpecDown refreshes saved Markdown files automatically, so you can review each revision as you iterate.
mac.description:
Keep a clear view of your AI work as it takes shape.

SpecDown is a Markdown reading companion for AI-assisted work. Open a spec, plan, README or technical note beside your AI tool or editor. When that tool saves the Markdown file, SpecDown refreshes the preview automatically, so you can review the latest revision and decide what to change next.

STAY WITH THE ITERATION
• Open a local Markdown file and keep its preview visible
• See saved file changes without reopening the document
• Compare the raw source with the rendered result in split view
• Work across several documents in tabs

UNDERSTAND THE DETAILS
• Read formatted headings, lists, tables and highlighted code
• Explore Mermaid flowcharts, sequence diagrams, state diagrams and Gantt charts
• Zoom and pan through diagrams in fullscreen
• Jump through long documents with the table of contents
• Print a document or export it as a PDF

SpecDown works with Markdown from your preferred AI tool or editor. Use your existing writing workflow, save the file, and review the result in SpecDown. It also works with documents written entirely by people.

No account is needed. SpecDown has no ads or analytics. Documents render on your Mac; opening online documents or remote images connects directly to their hosts.

review_notes:
SpecDown displays Markdown documents and Mermaid diagrams. It supports reviewing documents created by external AI tools; it does not generate text, run an AI model, or require an AI account. No sign-in is required.

To review on iPhone or iPad:
1. Launch SpecDown and open the bundled Diagram Showcase.
2. Expand a diagram, then zoom and pan.
3. Use Contents to jump between sections and Raw to inspect the Markdown source.
4. Open Sample to inspect text, tables, code and HTML comments. Use More to show or hide the comments.
5. Open a .md file from Files or iCloud Drive.

The iOS app displays the document loaded into it. The automatic refresh of saved local files described in desktop materials is a desktop feature.

The viewer is bundled locally. Online documents and remote images are fetched directly from their hosts. The app contains no ads, analytics or tracking. Tapped links open in Safari.

NSAllowsArbitraryLoadsInWebContent allows user-opened Markdown documents to display images from plain-HTTP servers.
